Seen • Just now
Yes, we do offer price matching for price drops that occur after your purchase!
Price Matching Policy:
If the price of the same new item is reduced by Avocado or by an authorized retailer within 30 days after your purchase date, we will refund the difference to your original form of payment.
Requirements:
You must contact our Customer Experience team within 30 days of your order date and provide proof of the lower advertised price.
The item must be identical in model, size, and color, and it must be in stock at the time of the request.
The lower price must be publicly advertised and verifiable.
Only offers from authorized retailers qualify — we do not match prices from auction sites, marketplaces, resellers, or unauthorized retailers.
Important Notes:
This policy applies only to future price reductions that occur after your purchase. It does not apply to lower prices, promotions, or discounts that were already available at the time you placed your order.
If a promotion occurs shortly after your purchase and results in a lower price, you can contact us to discuss potential refund options.
Coupons and discount codes cannot be retroactively applied or switched after purchase.
Upon approval, you'll receive an email confirmation, and the refunded amount may take several days to reflect based on your bank's processing times.

What's your warranty policy on defective items?
• Just now
Seen • Just now
Our warranty policy covers manufacturing defects and varies by product. Here's what you need to know:
Warranty Coverage by Product:
Mattresses:
Green, Vegan, Wool, Extra Firm, Latex, Luxury Organic, Grand Luxe, Organic Crib, Luxury Organic Crib Mattresses: 25-year limited warranty
Eco Organic, Eco Organic Kids, Eco Organic Crib, Eco Organic Mini Crib, Organic 11" Hybrid Mattresses: 10-year limited warranty
Toppers:
Organic Latex, Luxury Organic, Vegan Mattress Toppers: 10-year limited warranty
Eco Organic, Alpaca Wool Mattress Toppers: 1-year limited warranty
Coverage Structure for 25-Year Mattresses:
Years 1-10 are fully covered and non-prorated — no charge for repair or replacement if a defect qualifies, with shipping and pickup included. Years 11-25 are prorated, beginning at 50% of the original purchase price in year 11 and increasing by 5% per year.
What's Covered:
Visible indentations of 1.5 inches or greater (measured without weight on the mattress) that are not caused by an improper foundation. For Luxury Plush and Ultra Plush models, the threshold is 2 inches. For crib mattresses, it's 3/4 inch.
Physical flaws in natural latex foam that cause it to split or crack under normal use.
Furniture damage: If your furniture arrives damaged, contact us within 3 days of delivery to arrange a repair, replacement, or return. Returns due to verified manufacturing defects are eligible for a full refund or replacement, including shipping fees, under our warranty.
What's NOT Covered:
Normal body impressions — the natural, even compression of wool, cotton, and the quilted cover — are not covered under warranty and are not grounds for a return.
How to File a Claim:
Submit a request to support@avocadomattress.com with evidence of the defect and proof of purchase. Our team will review your submission and determine if the defect is covered. If approved, we'll ship a replacement upon proof that you returned the defective item.
The warranty extends to the original purchaser and applies only to products purchased directly from Avocado or an authorized reseller.
